screening_decisions.reason: RCT in women with stress urinary incontinence. Three arms: PFM exercises via digital palpation, PFM exercises via biofeedback, and control group with no exercises. Meets all criteria.
RCT in women with SUI. App treatment arm (98.4% performed PFMT) vs control group with postponed treatment (inactive control). Meets all criteria.
RCT in postmenopausal women with SUI. Three arms: control (no treatment), PFME alone, and PFME+BF. Meets all criteria.
